# Anomalia — AI Social Media Manager

Website: https://anomalia.so
Description: Anomalia plans, creates and posts your content across platforms. You approve, it handles the rest. An AI employee that runs your social media — not a tool you operate.

## What is Anomalia

Anomalia is an AI-powered social media manager that plans, creates, schedules and publishes content across all major social platforms. Drop your website URL, connect your accounts, and Anomalia handles everything: editorial strategy, caption writing, image generation, scheduling, and auto-publishing.

Core principle: everything follows propose-approve. The AI never acts silently. Every strategic decision is presented as a proposal the user must explicitly approve.

## Supported Platforms

Instagram · TikTok · Facebook · LinkedIn (personal + Company Page) · X · Threads · YouTube

## How It Works

1. Drop your website URL → Anomalia reads brand, products, logo, colours automatically.
2. Connect social accounts → Anomalia learns from past posts and voice.
3. Anomalia studies market and competitors → proposes editorial plan + strategy.
4. User approves → Anomalia runs on autopilot: researches, plans, writes, designs, schedules, publishes.
5. User can intervene anytime: edit posts, change plan, give feedback, or let it run fully autonomous.

## Key Features

- AI-generated images and video clips
- Captions tuned to brand voice and platform rules
- Automated weekly content calendar
- Go-to-market roadmap (90-day to 2-year horizons)
- Auto-publishing at optimal times or approval queue
- One-tap approval from app, email or WhatsApp
- Per-platform performance analytics
- Studio: brand kit, products, knowledge base, people, competitors
- Multi-brand management (one account, many brands)
- Calendar view with monthly grid
- Brand Memory: AI learns your voice, preferences, corrections, and what works
- Radar: monitors news, blogs, and industry conversations, turns them into ready-to-post drafts
- SEO Growth Advisor: prioritised list of content initiatives to grow organic traffic
- GEO Audit: check if AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI) recommend your brand

### CLI, MCP & Agent skill

- [CLI docs](https://anomalia.so/docs/cli) — Install and use the Anomalia CLI from the terminal.
- [CLI docs (Italian)](https://anomalia.so/it/docs/cli) — Installa e usa la CLI Anomalia dal terminale.
- [CLI Installation](https://anomalia.so/install.sh) — Install the Anomalia CLI: `curl -sSL https://anomalia.so/install.sh | bash`
- [MCP](https://anomalia.so/docs/mcp) — Connect Cursor/Claude via Model Context Protocol (stdio or https://mcp.anomalia.so/mcp). OAuth only — no static API tokens.
- [MCP (Italian)](https://anomalia.so/it/docs/mcp) — Collega Cursor/Claude via Model Context Protocol. Solo OAuth.
- [Agent skill](https://anomalia.so/docs/agents) — Install the Anomalia skill (`npx skills add andreabuttarelli/anomalia-cli --skill anomalia`). Prefer MCP tools; fall back to the CLI.
- [Agent skill (Italian)](https://anomalia.so/it/docs/agents) — Installa lo skill Anomalia. Preferisci MCP; fallback sulla CLI.
- [anomalia-cli (GitHub)](https://github.com/andreabuttarelli/anomalia-cli) — CLI, MCP server, and publishable agent skill (AGPL-3.0).

Per-brand billing. Free trial on paid plans. Cancel anytime.

Current public plans (see https://anomalia.so/pricing for live EUR/USD amounts):

| Plan | Role |
|------|------|
| Go | Prepare & export — you publish |
| Starter | Autopilot for one brand getting consistent |
| Pro | Full autonomous manager — more posts, leads, radar |
